# Piano accompaniments

Hymn Commons / Ron Nelson. Downloaded November 13, 2026; connected at Daniel’s request in revision 10.10. Files are unmodified. The creator states site materials are public domain: https://hymncommons.org/about/

Christmas listing: https://hymncommons.org/hymn-commons-home/christmas-public-domain-carols/

- o-little-town.mp3: https://hymncommons.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/o-little-town-of-bethlehem.mp3
- silent-night.mp3: https://hymncommons.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/silent-night.mp3
- away-in-a-manger.mp3: https://hymncommons.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/away-in-a-manger.mp3
- midnight-clear.mp3: https://hymncommons.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/it-came-upon-a-midnight-clear.mp3

The matching score tempi, pickup bars and repeats provide the initial timing maps. MP3s decode to non-silent PCM in ffmpeg and Chromium; no auditory quality review is claimed. Original file hashes and lyric edition IDs accompany each recording in ../config.js. The complete game handoff also contains analysis, source snapshots and reproducible timing preparation.
